name: Repair Jammer - Crit
RelatedDescription: An engineering backpack fitted with a high-precision robotic arm that provides professional repairs on the battlefield. Also integrates a function that affects the enemy's Crit capability.

61251.name: Repair Device I · Crit
61251.SpecificEffects:
When the action starts, repair yourself <color=#F74848>once</color>, restoring HP equal to <color=#F74848>0.6x</color> the Manipulator's Repair AMT. This cannot repair damaged parts.
In combat, the enemy's Crit Rate <color=#F74848>-10%</color>.
